name: limit_iges_of_an_assembly
why: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW OF 27/9/2026. With Z-D6 export_iges too accepted an assembly, but without the check of the solids that STEP has, and the result depends on a global preference (swIGESComponentsIntoOneFile) that the bridge does not set: with it off SOLIDWORKS writes one file per component, and the one in «path» may not contain the whole assembly. Until it is measured, the IGES of an assembly is refused and points to STEP.
defect_caught: An assembly IGES taken as good without knowing whether the whole assembly is inside.
